title: Attention at SemEval-2023 Task 10: Explainable Detection of Online Sexism (EDOS)

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fine-tuned transformer models (RoBERTa, DeBERTa) using Macro F1 scores on binary, 4-class categorical, and 11-class fine-grained classification tasks to detect and categorize sexist text in social media posts from Reddit and Gab.
